exact_statement: For N iid Bernoulli failure observations with unknown policy failure probability p, every uniformly valid one-sided (1-alpha) upper confidence bound U must satisfy U(0,...,0) >= epsilon whenever (1-epsilon)^N > alpha. Therefore certifying p <= epsilon after zero observed failures requires N >= ceil(log(alpha)/log(1-epsilon)).
assumptions: one fixed feedback policy is evaluated across independent reset runs
the model class contains the Bernoulli rare-shock family with observationally identical no-failure paths
no parametric transition model, valid likelihood ratio, or safety certificate is supplied
the confidence statement is uniform over p in [0,1]
status: proved_here; standard exact-binomial content; no novelty claim
novelty_boundary: This is a direct coverage argument and exact zero-count binomial limit, not a new confidence interval. The workstream contribution is its explicit application to frozen feedback-policy certification and matched cost accounting against supplied-certificate operation-time guarantees.

Thus its certified exponentially long finite horizon does not imply all-time containment or stochastic permanence.

closed class of total population V and V>=6
